purpose: Define the monetary-system contract by which Smart Vote may propose, approve or review monetary policy without duplicating Smart Vote internals.
governance_constraints: Domain relevance must affect influence; generic prestige alone is insufficient.
Integrity weighting must be rule-governed, evidence-backed, appealable and applicable symmetrically rather than a free-form moral score.
Expert influence must be bounded to prevent expert-sovereignty or a single-person veto.
Conflicts of interest must be represented explicitly.
Emergency authority must be bounded, expire automatically and receive post-hoc review.
Raw participation and weighted interpretation remain separately inspectable when the external Smart Vote system provides both.
epistemic_rule: A Smart Vote decision is a decision record, not empirical proof that the policy will work.
